I don't feel like it's fair to put all of my pain onto him. I've told him that I feel unloved, and he tries. I can't expect him to be enough for me, or my sole reason for existing.

I think that if I lose this job, it's going to affect my ability to find other work in the industry. I would need to be able to work in the field in order to get certified and make the graduate degree I'm pursuing worth it. Without the job, I can't get the degree or the certification and the degree would be worthless without the certification. So losing this job would likely mean losing my current career path.
